items.name: DiagnosticKind
items.summary: A [`Diagnostic`] can either be a hard error that prevents the query from being planned and executed, or a warning that indicates potential issues, performance problems, or causes for unexpected results, but is non-fatal. This enum expresse…

items.name: Diagnostic
items.summary: Additional contextual information intended for end users, to help them understand what went wrong by providing human-readable messages, and locations in the source query that relate to the error in some way.

methods.name: add_help
methods.signature: fn add_help(&mut self, message: impl Into<String>, span: Option<Span>)
methods.summary: Adds a "help" to the [`Diagnostic`], which can have zero or many. A "help" helps the user understand how they might fix the error or warning. It can refer to an arbitrary location in the SQL query, or to no location.

methods.name: add_note
methods.signature: fn add_note(&mut self, message: impl Into<String>, span: Option<Span>)
methods.summary: Adds a "note" to the [`Diagnostic`], which can have zero or many. A "note" helps contextualize the error and helps the end user understand why it occurred. It can refer to an arbitrary location in the SQL query, or to no location.

methods.name: new_error
methods.signature: fn new_error(message: impl Into<String>, span: Option<Span>) -> Self
methods.summary: Creates a new [`Diagnostic`] for a fatal error that prevents the SQL query from being planned and executed. Optionally takes in a [`Span`] to describe the location in the source code that caused the error, should be provided when available.

methods.name: new_warning
methods.signature: fn new_warning(message: impl Into<String>, span: Option<Span>) -> Self
methods.summary: Creates a new [`Diagnostic`] for a NON-fatal warning, such as a performance problem, or possible cause for undesired results. Optionally takes in a [`Span`] to describe the location in the source code that caused the error, should be provi…

methods.name: with_help
methods.signature: fn with_help(self, message: impl Into<String>, span: Option<Span>) -> Self
methods.summary: Like [`Diagnostic::add_help`], but returns `self` to allow chaining.

methods.name: with_note
methods.signature: fn with_note(self, message: impl Into<String>, span: Option<Span>) -> Self
methods.summary: Like [`Diagnostic::add_note`], but returns `self` to allow chaining.

items.name: DiagnosticHelp
items.summary: A "help" enriches a [`Diagnostic`] with extra information, possibly referring to different locations in the original SQL query, that helps the user understand how they might fix the error or warning.

items.name: DiagnosticNote
items.summary: A note enriches a [`Diagnostic`] with extra information, possibly referring to different locations in the original SQL query, that helps contextualize the error and helps the end user understand why it occurred.
